rules.userFacingText: No user-facing text may be hardcoded. Every user-facing label, message, error, empty state, loading state, dialog, notification, email subject/body, CTA, accessibility label and status must render through x()/t() or an equivalent governed localization layer.
rules.englishSource: English source/catalog is authoritative for semantic keys and source copy.
rules.selectedLanguage: When an enabled language is selected, that language's governed value is rendered.
rules.missingUnreviewed: For a supported non-English locale, a missing, empty, whitespace-only, or explicit [key] value resolves to the authoritative English catalog value. Unsupported/unavailable locales also use governed English fallback; a literal [key] must not surface when an English value exists.
rules.unavailableLocale: When the selected locale/catalog is unsupported or unavailable, use governed English fallback. For supported locales, per-key English fallback is also required when the selected value is missing, empty, whitespace-only, or an explicit [key] placeholder.
rules.platformContract: Web, Android and iOS use the same localization key and semantic contract.
rules.environment: Development and Production use the same governed localization source; both therefore use the same localization source, key contract, fallback policy, locale registry behavior and UI primitives. Only secrets and external-service activation may differ.
rules.nativeReview: Native/reviewed status may only be certified from actual evidence; no machine-generated or guessed translation may be promoted to reviewed production copy.
